अद् --द a. (at the end of comp.)
Eating, devouring; मांसाद
carnivorous, feeding on flesh; so मत्स्य˚.

आदा {c3c} A. (आदत्ते)
1 To receive,
accept, take (to oneself), resort to;
व्यवहारासनमाददे युवा

.
--2
(With words expressing speech) To
begin to speak, utter; वाचं आदा to
speak, utter; विनिश्चितार्थामिति वाचमाददे

; स हि सर्वस्य लोकस्य
मन आददे

attracted, had a
hold on, the mind.
--4 To put on
(as clothes &c.); यद्यच्छरीरमादत्ते
Śvet. Up.
--5 To take up, absorb,
drink up;

; प्रदीपः स्नेहमादत्ते
दशयाभ्यंतरस्थया Śi. 2. 85.
--6 To
exact, take in (as taxes); take away,
carry off; अगृध्नुराददे सोर्थं

carrying or along with
the net; कुशानादाय Ś. 3; तोयमादाय
गच्छेः

; see आदाय
below; काश्यपसंदेशमादाय bearing K. 's
message.
--9 To perceive,
comprehend; घ्राणेन रूपमादत्स्व रसानादत्स्व
चक्षुषा श्रोत्रेण गंधानादत्स्व &c. Mb.
--10
To agree to, undertake, begin.
--11
To imprison, make captive. --Caus.
To cause to take. --Desid. (दित्सते)
To wish to take, carry off &c.

आद a. (At the end of comp.)
Taking, receiving; as in दायाद.

अदंष्ट्र a. [न. ब.] Toothless.
--ष्ट्रः
A serpent without teeth; one whose
fangs have been taken out.

अदक्षिण a. [न. त.]
1 Not right,
left.
--2 [न. ब.] Not bringing in
Dakṣiṇā to the priests; without
any gifts (as a sacrifice); मृतो
यज्ञस्त्वदक्षिणः

.
--3 Simple,
weakminded, silly; मेनेऽथ सत्यमेवेति
परिहासमदक्षिणा Rām.
--4 Not handy,
skilful or clever; awkward.
--5
Unfavourable.

अदग्ध a. Not burnt; not burnt
according to the rites.

अदंड a. [न. ब.] Free or exempt
from punishment.

अदंड्य a.
1 Not deserving
punishment; अदंड्यान् दंडयन् राजा
दंड्यांश्चैवाप्यदंडयन्

.
--2 Exempt or free from
punishment; नादंड्यो नाम राज्ञोस्ति यः
स्वधर्मे न तिष्ठति

अदत्त a.
1 Not given.
--2
Unjustly or improperly given.
--3 Not
given in marriage.
--4 Not having
given any thing.
--त्ता An
unmarried girl.
--त्तं A gift which is null
and void (having been given under
particular circumstances which make
it revocable).
--Comp.
--आदायिन् a.
the receiver of such a gift; one who
takes what has not been given away,
such as a thief; अदत्तादायिनो हस्ताल्लिप्सेत
ब्राह्मणो धनं । याजनाध्यापनेनापि यथा स्तेनस्तथैव
सः ॥
--पूर्वा Not affianced or
betrothed before; अदत्तपूर्वेत्याशंक्यते

आदत्त, आत्त p. p. [आ-दा-क्त]
1
Taken, received, assumed, accepted;
आत्तसारश्चक्षुषा स्वविषयः

.
--2 Agreed
to, undertaken, begun.
--3
Attracted.
--4 Drawn out, extracted;
गामात्तसारां रघुरप्यवेक्ष्य

; ˚बलं
11. 76 taken away.
--Comp.
--गंध a. {1}
having one's pride humbled,
attacked, insulted, defeated; पक्षच्छिदा
गोत्रभिदात्तगंधाः

; केनात्तगंधो
माणवकः Ś. 6. {2} already smelt (as
a flower); आत्तगंधमवधूय शत्रुभिः
Śi. 14. 84 (where आ˚ has sense 1
also).
--गर्व a. humiliated, insulted,
degraded.
--दंड a. assuming the
royal sceptre; Ś. 5. 8.
--मनस्क a. one
whose mind is transported (with
joy &c).
--लक्ष्मी a. stripped of
wealth.
--वचस् a. Ved. {1}
destitute of speech. {2} having
commenced speaking.

अदत्र a. [अद्-वा˚ अत्रन्] Ved. Fit
to be eaten; अदत्रया दयते वार्याणि

-81]
Going to that, tending to that.
[1] Correction submitted by @aumsanskrit on 20251225. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/csl-corrections/issues/104 ap90. note: headword change.
[2] Correction submitted by @aumsanskrit on 20251225. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/csl-corrections/issues/104 ap90.

अदंत a. [न. ब.]
1 Toothless.
--2
Not yet having the teeth formed
or grown (said of young ones of
men or animals before the teething
time).
--3 Ending in अत् or अ.
--तः
1 A leech.
--2 N. of Pūṣan, one
of the 12 Ādityas, he having lost
his teeth at the destruction of
Dakṣa's sacrifice by Vīrabhadra.

अदंत्य a.
1 Not dental.
--2 Not fit
for the teeth; injurious to them.

अदब्ध, --दंभ a. [न. त.] Ved.
Unbroken or unimpaired, unhurt,
uninjured; pure, true; ˚असु, or ˚आयुः
having uninjured or pure life;
leaving uninjured the man who
sacrifices; ˚धीति, ˚व्रत whose works or
religious observances are unimpaired.

अदब्ध, --दंभ a. [न. त.] Ved.
Unbroken or unimpaired, unhurt,
uninjured; pure, true; ˚असु, or ˚आयुः
having uninjured or pure life;
leaving uninjured the man who
sacrifices; ˚धीति, ˚व्रत whose works or
religious observances are unimpaired.

अदंभ a. Honest, undeceitful.
--भः
1 Honesty, absence of deceit.
--2
N. of Śiva.

अदय [न. ब.] Merciless,
unkind, cruel.
--यं ind. Mercilessly;
ardently; fervently, closely (as an
embrace)

अदाय a. [नास्ति दायो यस्य] Not
entitled to a share.

आदाय ind. Having taken; oft.
with a prepositional force ‘with;’
जालमादाय

1 Day of new moon.
--2 A
mirror (= आदर्श).

आदर्शः [आदृश्यतेऽत्र, दृश् आधारे घञ्]
1 A mirror, a looking-glass;
आत्मानमालोक्य च शोभमानमादर्शबिंबे
स्तिमितायताक्षी

.
--2 The original
manuscript from which a copy is
taken; (fig.) a pattern, model,
type; आदर्शः शिक्षितानां

; so गुणानां
&c.
--3 A copy of a work.
--4
A commentary, gloss.
--5 A
particular boundary of a country.
[]
--6 N. of a country.
--Comp.
--मंडलः
{1} a globular mirror. {2} the
surface of a mirror
--(लं). {3} a kind
of snake (with globular spots).

the person whose
sight one wishes to avoid; ˚नं गतः

lost to view, become invisible.
--2
Neglect, or failure to see; ब्राह्मणादर्शनेन च

1 Showing, making
apparent, displaying.
--2 A mirror.

अदल a.
1 Leafless.
--2 Without
parts.
--लः A plant (हिज्जल) Eugenia
or Barringtonia Acutangula.
--ला A
plant (घृतकुमारी) Aloe Indica Royle.

अदस् pron. a. [न दस्यते उत्क्षिप्यते
[]
अंगुलिर्यत्र इदंतया निर्द्धारणाय पुरोवर्तिनि
एवांगुलिनिर्देशः संभवति नापुरोवर्तिनि, न-दस्-क्विप् Tv.]
(असौ m. f., अदः n.). That, (referring
to a person or thing not present or
near the speaker) (विप्रकृष्ट or परोक्ष);
इदमस्तु सन्निकृष्टं समीपतरवर्ति चैतदो रूपम् ।
अदसस्तु विप्रकृष्टं तदिति परोक्षे विजानीयात् ॥
अमुष्य विद्या रसनाग्रनर्तकी

. अदस् is,
however, often used with reference
to प्रत्यक्ष or सन्निकृष्ट objects &c. in the
sense of ‘this here’, ‘yonder’;
असौ शरण्यः शरणोन्मुखानां

(
असाविति पुरोवर्तिनो निर्देशः Malli.); अमी
रथ्याः Ś. 1. 8.; अमी वह्नयः 4. 17,
7. 11. It is often used in the sense of
तत् as a correlative of यत्; हिंसारतश्च
यो नित्यं नेहासौ सुखमेधते

he
who &c. But when it immediately
follows the relative pronoun (योसौ,
ये अमी &c.) it conveys the sense of
प्रसिद्ध ‘well-known’, ‘celebrated’,
‘renowned’; योसावतीद्रियग्राह्यः सूक्ष्मोऽ
व्यक्तः सनातनः

;
sometimes अदस् used by itself
conveys this sense; विधुरपि
विधियोगाद्ग्रस्यते राहुणाऽसौ that (so well-known
to us all) moon too. See the word
तद् also and the quotations from K. P
--ind. There, at that time, then, thus,
ever; correlative to some pronominal
forms; यदादः, यत्रादः whenever,
whereever &c. By अदोऽनुपदेशे

अदस् has the force of a (गति)
preposition when no direction to another
is implied; अदः कृत्य अदः कृतं; । परं
प्रत्युपदेशे तु अदः कृत्वा अदः कुरु । Sk.
अदस्यति Den. P. To become that

not
liberal
--2 Not giving (a daughter)
in marriage; कालेऽदाता पिता वाच्यः

आदातृ a. One who takes or
receives.

अदादि a. Having अद् at the head,
a term used to mark roots of the
second conjugation.

अदान a. [न. ब.]
1 Not giving,
miserly.
--2 Without rut (or not
charitable); सदादानः परिक्षीणः शस्त
एव करीश्वरः । अदानः पीनगात्रोपि निंद्य
एव हि गर्दभः

अदान्य, अदायिन्, अदामन्,
अदाशु, अदाशुरि, -दाश्वस् a. Ved. Not giving,
[]
miserly, poor; irreligious, impious.

अदान्य, अदायिन्, अदामन्,
अदाशु, अदाशुरि, -दाश्वस् a. Ved. Not giving,
[]
miserly, poor; irreligious, impious.

आदायिन् a. Taking, receiving,
inclined to receive (gifts); अदत्त˚,
परस्व˚ &c.

अदान्य, अदायिन्, अदामन्,
अदाशु, अदाशुरि, -दाश्वस् a. Ved. Not giving,
[]
miserly, poor; irreligious, impious.

अदान्य, अदायिन्, अदामन्,
अदाशु, अदाशुरि, -दाश्वस् a. Ved. Not giving,
[]
miserly, poor; irreligious, impious.

अदान्य, अदायिन्, अदामन्,
अदाशु, अदाशुरि, -दाश्वस् a. Ved. Not giving,
[]
miserly, poor; irreligious, impious.

अदान्य, अदायिन्, अदामन्,
अदाशु, अदाशुरि, -दाश्वस् a. Ved. Not giving,
[]
miserly, poor; irreligious, impious.

Faithful, trusty.
--2 Uninjured, unhurt.
--3 Pure,
undefiled.
--4 Unapproachable.

अदायाद a.
1 Not entitled to be an
heir; पुमान्दायादोऽदायादा स्त्री Nir.;
कानीनश्च सहोढश्च क्रीतः पौनर्भवस्तथा ।
स्वयंदत्तश्च शौद्रश्च षडदायादबांधवाः ॥

अदायिक a. (की f.) [दायमर्हति दाय-ठक्
न. ब.]
1 That which is not claimed
by an heir; destitute of heirs;
अदायिकं धनं राजगामि Kāty.
--2 Not
relating to inheritance.

अदारः [न. ब.]
1 One who has
no wife, a widower or bachelor.
--2
[न. त.] Not injuring or tearing.

आदरः [आ-दृ-कप्]
1 Respect,
reverence, honour; निर्माणमेव हि
तदादरलालनीयं

.
--2
Attention, care, notice, close
application; आदरप्रयत्न

; 13. 58. (b)
Earnest desire, request; Ś. 6.
--4 Effort, endeavour;
गृहयंत्रपताकाश्रीरपौरादरनिर्मिता

Allurement,
attraction, an instigator (Sāy.).
--2 N. of
a plant used instead of Soma (when
it is not available).

अदाह्य a.
1 Incombustible.
--2
Not fit to be burnt on the funeral
pile.
--3 Not capable of being burnt,
epithet of परमात्मन्.

आदंश् {c1c} P. To bite, peck at,
nibble.

1 A bite, a wound caused
by biting.
--2 A tooth.

आदघ्न a. Ved. Reaching up to
the mouth (आस्+दघ्न).

आदर, आदर्श &c. See under
आदृ, आदृश्.

आदर, आदर्श &c. See under
आदृ, आदृश्.

1 Burning.
--2 Injuring,
killing.
--3 Reviling, despising.
--4
A cemetery, a place where
anything is burnt (आदह्यतेस्मिन्निति).

.
--2
Earning, getting.
--3 A symptom (of a
disease).
--4 Binding, fettering
(from आदा {c2c} P.).
--5 A horse's
trappings.
--नी N. of a plant हस्तिघोषा.

आदापनं Inviting or causing
another to receive something.

आदायः Receiving, taking &c.
--Comp.
--चर a. one who goes away
after taking anything.

आदादिक a. Belonging to the
class of roots of which the first is
अद्, i. e. to the second class.

आदरणीय, आदर्तव्य pot. p.
Venerable, respectful.

आदरणीय, आदर्तव्य pot. p.
Venerable, respectful.

आदर्दिर^1 a. Ved. Crushing,
splitting open.
